lines.en: I tap on Tsukasa’s name in my phone because it’s what you want me to do.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Tsukasa 的名字,因为这是你想要我做的。

lines.en: But that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 但没关系。

lines.en: Because I want you to want me to do it.
lines.zh: : 因为「我想要你想要我做」。

lines.en: And I want her to want me to want you to want me to do it.
lines.zh: : 而我想要「她」想要「我想要你想要我做」。

lines.en: So it’s okay.
lines.zh: : 所以没问题。

lines.en: What I’m doing is okay.
lines.zh: : 我做的这件事,没问题。

lines.en: : Hello?
Except it’s not okay at all.
lines.zh: : 除了它完全不没问题。

lines.en: : Hey.
None of this is.
lines.zh: : 这一切都不对。

lines.en: : Ah! It’s Jeeves again.
lines.zh: : 啊!又是 Jeeves。

lines.en: : You’ll have to excuse me as I didn’t save your number the last time you called.
lines.zh: : 请你见谅,你上次打电话来,我没有存你的号码。

lines.en: : Should I take that as a subtle hint that you don’t want to see me anymore?
lines.zh: : 我该把这个当成含蓄的暗示——「你不想再见我了」——吗?

lines.en: : I never wanted to see you to begin with. You’re not even fit to breathe the same air as me.
lines.zh: : 我从一开始就没想见你。你连和我呼吸同一种空气的资格都没有。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. Well, I guess I’ll just hang up then.
lines.zh: : 哦,好吧。那我挂了。

lines.en: : Okay! Bye, Jeeves!
lines.zh: : 好!拜拜,Jeeves!

lines.en: : Jeeves, I understand that advanced technological devices like cell phones might be intimidating to you, but if you can figure out how to press the “call” button, surely you can also figure out how to-
lines.zh: : Jeeves,我理解,手机这类高级电子设备对你来说可能很可怕;但如果你能弄明白怎么按「拨号」, Surely 你也能弄明白怎么——

lines.en: : I know how to hang up the phone, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 我知道怎么挂电话,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Then why are you still taking up my time? You should know by now that I am a very busy girl.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还在占用我的时间?你现在应该知道,我是个非常忙的女孩。

lines.en: : Well, I apologize for interrupting your very busy schedule, but are you able to find any time to fit in some lessons today?
lines.zh: : 好吧,很抱歉打断你极其繁忙的日程——但你今天能抽出时间上一两节课吗?

lines.en: : What kind of lessons?
lines.zh: : 什么样的课?

lines.en: : Lessons in Love.
lines.zh: : 《Lessons in Love》。

lines.en: Thank you for playing!
lines.zh: : 感谢游玩!

lines.en: : What was that, Jeeves? The reception in your impoverished neighborhood prevented me from hearing you for a moment.
lines.zh: : 你说什么,Jeeves?你们贫民区的信号太差,我刚刚没听清。

lines.en: : Just...lessons in general. I don’t have anything else going on and figured now is as good a time as any to get some tutoring in.
lines.zh: : 就是……一般的课。我反正没别的事,觉得现在正是家教的好时机。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong, but I’m pretty sure that schedule should be up to me.
lines.zh: : 如果我理解错了请纠正我,但我相当确定,这个日程应该由我来定。

lines.en: : You’re wrong. I’m the educational professional here, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 你错了。这里的「教育专业人士」是我,不是吗?

lines.en: : Former professional, Jeeves. All you are now is an unemployed hack mooching off the 1%%.
lines.zh: : 「前」专业人士,Jeeves。你如今只是个蹭百分之一富人的无业游民。

lines.en: : Technically speaking, I haven’t formally quit yet.
lines.zh: : 严格来说,我还没有正式辞职。

lines.en: : So you’re still on the company’s payroll despite not doing any work?
lines.zh: : 所以,你什么都不做,却还在领公司的工资?

lines.en: : Right.
: Now you’re talking my language. But I’m surprised. I didn’t think you’d be calling again after the way our last session ended.
lines.zh: : 这才是我的语言嘛。但我很意外。上次那个结局之后,我以为你不会再打来了。

lines.en: : Yeah, let’s not talk about that. Are you home right now?
lines.zh: : 对,那个就别提了。你现在在家吗?

lines.en: : Technically speaking, yes. But it’s not the one you’re familiar with. I’m in my commoner room right now.
lines.zh: : 严格来说,在。但不是你熟悉的那个。我在我的平民房间里。

lines.en: : Don’t you mean “common room?”
lines.zh: : 你是想说「客厅」吧?

lines.en: : No.
: Oh. You mean the apartment.
lines.zh: : 哦。你是说那间公寓。

lines.en: : Shh! If my shareholders hear that I’m spending time in an apartment, ChinamiCorp is going to steal away even more of the market share than it already has!
lines.zh: : 嘘!要是我的股东们听说我在「公寓」里消磨时间,ChinamiCorp 会夺走比现在更多的市场份额!

lines.en: : So...am I coming over? Or are you so busy acting poor that you’d rather be alone?
lines.zh: : 那么……我是过来?还是你忙着装穷,宁愿独处?

lines.en: : I suppose I can make some time for the sake of my education. But I will ask you to leave all recording devices at home as I simply can not afford ever being spotted in a place like this.
lines.zh: : 为了我的教育,我可以腾点时间。但我要请你把所有录音设备留在家里——被人发现在我这种地方,我是绝对承受不起的。

lines.en: : Can I bring my phone?
lines.zh: : 那我能带手机吗?

lines.en: : Yes, but do not be surprised if I ask you to lock it in a safe upon arrival.
lines.zh: : 可以,但到了之后,如果我让你把它锁进保险箱,不要惊讶。

lines.en: : Sure, fine.
lines.zh: : 行,好。

lines.en: : Go ahead and teleport me now.
lines.zh: : 现在就把我传送过来吧。

lines.en: : Teleport you?
lines.zh: : 传送你?

lines.en: : Like you did last time.
lines.zh: : 就像上次那样。

lines.en: : Jeeves, do you suffer from brain damage? I may be rich, but I can not teleport people. Such a method of transportation hasn’t been developed yet.
lines.zh: : Jeeves,你的脑子是不是受过损伤?我是有钱,但我不会传送人。这种交通方式还没被发明出来。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Anyway! I must be going now, but I’m sure you’ll be able to find the way here on your own! Bye, Jeeves!
lines.zh: : 总之!我现在必须走了,不过我确信,你能自己找到路!拜拜,Jeeves!

lines.en: : Tsu-
lines.zh: : Tsu——

lines.en: : ...kasa.
lines.zh: : ……kasa。

lines.en: Sighing to myself and wondering whether or not the act of teleportation will ever again be touched on, I set off toward Tsukasa’s apartment.
lines.zh: : 我暗自叹气,不知道传送这件事还会不会被再提起,然后动身前往 Tsukasa 的公寓。

lines.en: And while I’m willing to chalk that last visit up to just one more strange, paranormal occurrence in a life that is now full of them, I’d more than welcome additional instances of that one in the future.
lines.zh: : 虽然我愿意把上一次归结为「这个如今塞满怪事的的人生里,又一起灵异事件」,但我十二万分欢迎那一幕在未来重演。

lines.en: Because at least that one makes my life easier and doesn’t pressure me into violating every single girl I come across.
lines.zh: : 因为至少那一次,让我的人生变轻松了,而且没有逼我去侵犯我遇到的每一个女孩。

lines.en: : Jeeves!
lines.zh: : Jeeves!

lines.en: As I step into the room, I think about how this would look to everyone else.
lines.zh: : 走进房间时,我在想这在别人眼里会是什么样子。

lines.en: Would they be surprised to see that I have fallen this far? Would they shrug it off and trick themselves into believing there’s nothing to it whatsoever?
lines.zh: : 他们看到我堕落至此,会震惊吗?会耸耸肩、骗自己说「这根本没什么」吗?

lines.en: Or would they be excited to be shown a glimpse into a life even darker than the ones I’ve stolen all the lights from?
lines.zh: : 还是会兴奋——因为终于能窥见一段比「我偷走所有灯光的那些人生」更暗的人生?

lines.en: I think the answer would differ from person to person.
lines.zh: : 我想,答案因人而异。

lines.en: Right now, though, the ones who I most want to see me are the ones who would take me away.
lines.zh: : 但此刻,我最希望看见我的那些人,恰恰是会把我带走的人。

lines.en: The Toukas and Futabas. The Norikos and Nikis. And everyone in between who pretends that a moral compass always points northbound when, sometimes, compasses just don’t work.
lines.zh: : Touka 们,Futaba 们。Noriko 们,Niki 们。以及夹在中间的所有人——那些假装「道德罗盘永远指向正北」的人,尽管有时候,罗盘就是会失灵。

lines.en: Right now, I am lost.
lines.zh: : 此刻,我迷路了。

lines.en: And all I can do is hope that this unlikely candidate can point me back in the right direction.
lines.zh: : 而我唯一能做的,是寄希望于这个不大可能的候选,能把我指回正确的方向。

lines.en: : This...looks different from the other rooms.
lines.zh: : 这……看起来和其他房间不一样。

lines.en: : Cool, right? I hired a team of designers to make it look as close to the living quarters of an “average commoner girl” as possible.
lines.zh: : 酷吧?我雇了一个设计师团队,把它布置得尽可能接近「普通平民女孩」的起居室。

lines.en: : And...their idea of “average commoner girl” included suits of armor, crystal chandeliers, and a suitcase full of money?
lines.zh: : 而且……他们理解的「普通平民女孩」,包括盔甲、水晶吊灯,和一箱子现金?

lines.en: : The suitcase I brought from home. I intended to order a “pizza” today and am not sure what the going rate for those in today’s economy is.
lines.zh: : 现金箱是我从家里带来的。我打算今天点一份「披萨」,但不太确定当今经济环境下,那玩意的市场价。

lines.en: : Well, I’m sorry to break it to you, but you might need another suitcase.
lines.zh: : 嗯,很抱歉告诉你,你可能还需要再带一箱。

lines.en: : Wow. Life must be really scary out here, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇。外面的世界一定很可怕,啊?

lines.en: : Yeah. But if worse comes to worst, we can always sell our crystal chandeliers.
lines.zh: : 对。不过真到万不得已,我们总可以卖掉水晶吊灯。

lines.en: : Exactly! And here you were insinuating that my designers were not accurately replicating the ideal commoner apartment!
lines.zh: : exactly!你之前还在暗示,我的设计师没能精确复刻「理想平民公寓」!

lines.en: : So, remember how I was talking about how your next lesson should be on sarcasm?
lines.zh: : 那么,还记得我说过「你的下一课应该是反讽」吗?

lines.en: : That sounds so boring, though. I want to learn about math.
lines.zh: : 但那听起来好无聊。我想学数学。

lines.en: : Then there is a certain glasses-sporting porn shop employee I think you should meet as you two would get along very well.
lines.zh: : 那我觉得,有位戴眼镜的色情用品店员工,你应该见一见——你们俩会非常合得来。

lines.en: : What’s a “porn shop?”
lines.zh: : 什么是「色情用品店」?

lines.en: : Nothing. Anyway, time to learn things.
lines.zh: : 没什么。总之,上课时间到。

lines.en: : You can not just pique the curiosity of a girl as adventurous and excitable as me and then pull the rug out, Jeeves. I could have your hands for such a thing.
lines.zh: : 你不能这样——撩起一个像我这样爱冒险、易兴奋的女孩的好奇心,再把地毯抽走,Jeeves。就为这个,我可以要你的双手。

lines.en: : Or you could forget I said anything at all and we could start fresh right now. Hi. I’m Sensei. I’m here to teach you stuff.
lines.zh: : 或者你可以忘掉我刚才说的每一个字,我们现在重新开始。嗨。我是 Sensei。我来教你东西。

lines.en: : About porn?
lines.zh: : 关于色情的?

lines.en: : Do you have, like...a spray bottle I could shoot you with every time you say something you’re not supposed to say?
lines.zh: : 你有没有……那种喷水壶?每次你说了不该说的话,我就滋你一下?

lines.en: : Do I look like a cat to you?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像猫吗?

lines.en: : Unfortunately, yes. But there’s a certain level of nuance to that answer that even years worth of careful tutoring would not help you understand. Or would. But that makes it even worse.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是,像。但那个答案里有某种微妙之处,即使经过数年的精心辅导,你也无法理解。或者说能理解——但那样更糟。

lines.en: : I’m starting to think we’re not going to be learning about math today either.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得,今天也不是学数学的日子。

lines.en: : And I’m starting to think this was a very bad idea.
lines.zh: : 而我也开始觉得,这是一个非常糟糕的主意。

lines.en: : Like I said on the phone, I’m surprised you even called again. But that’s also what I said last time, so I guess you’re just full of surprises, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 就像我在电话里说的,你能再打来,我已经很意外了。但那也是我上次说的,所以你大概就是惊喜不断吧,不是吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, but not really in a good way.
lines.zh: : 对,但都不是好的那种。

lines.en: : I’ll say. The last person who touched my head like that was eaten by an Irish bloodhound.
lines.zh: : 我正要说。上一个像我这样摸你头的人,被一只爱尔兰寻血猎犬吃了。

lines.en: : Okay. Let’s move on.
lines.zh: : 好。我们继续。

lines.en: : Good idea! I’ll get on the bed!
lines.zh: : 好主意!我上床去!

lines.en: : That’s not what I-
lines.zh: : 我说的不是——

lines.en: : Come on, Jeeves! It’ll be just like last time! And this time, you have nowhere to run!
lines.zh: : 来嘛,Jeeves!就像上次一样!而且这次,你无处可逃!

lines.en: : That’s not a good thing...
lines.zh: : 那不是好事……

lines.en: : So, I’ve been thinking.
lines.zh: : 那么,我一直在想。

lines.en: : That’s new.
lines.zh: : 新鲜事。

lines.en: : And that’s rude. But what I mean is I’ve been thinking about you.
lines.zh: : 而这很无礼。但我的意思是:我一直在想「你」。

lines.en: : That’s worrying.
lines.zh: : 这让人担忧。

lines.en: : And that’s confusing. But what I mean by that is that I don’t really think you’re cut out to be my tutor, Jeeves. So I’m going to have to let you go. I’m sorry it had to end this way.
lines.zh: : 而这让人费解。但我的意思是:我 really 不觉得你适合当我的家教,Jeeves。所以我不得不放你走。很抱歉以这种方式收场。

lines.en: : All things considered, this is probably the best way this could have ended. So thanks, I guess.
lines.zh: : 综合来看,这大概是这件事最好的结局。所以,谢了,我猜。

lines.en: : You probably could have told me that before I came all the way over here, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你其实可以在我大老远赶来之前就告诉我。

lines.en: : I could have. But it would have likely prevented you from hearing my new job offer.
lines.zh: : 我可以。但那样的话,你多半就听不到我的新工作邀约了。

lines.en: : New job offer?
lines.zh: : 新工作邀约?

lines.en: : Of associate executive literary entertainment coordinator.
lines.zh: : 「副主任级文学娱乐协调专员」。

lines.en: : Pass.
lines.zh: : 驳回。

lines.en: : But I haven’t even described the job yet!
lines.zh: : 可我还没介绍这份工作呢!

lines.en: : Yeah, but the title is too long and I know you’d just make me say it all the time.
lines.zh: : 是,但那个头衔太长了,而且我知道你会让我天天挂在嘴边。

lines.en: : It fits your interests a lot better, though! I’m doing this for you!
lines.zh: : 但它和你的兴趣契合得多!我是为你好!

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Jeeves, as both your previous and future employer, it’s only right that I be honest with you. And the truth is that I never wanted to let you go at all.
lines.zh: : Jeeves,作为你的前任兼未来雇主,坦诚相待才对。而真相是:我从来就没想过放你走。

lines.en: : You just told me I wasn’t cut out for this like five seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 你五秒钟前才说我不适合这行。

lines.en: : Sometimes, being a CEO means making hard decisions. And also lying repeatedly until you’re caught and the business gets dragged under and you have to file for chapter 11.
lines.zh: : 有时候,当 CEO 就意味着做出艰难的决定。还要反复撒谎,直到被抓包、公司被拖垮、你不得不申请第十一章破产保护。

lines.en: : ...Okay?
: I still want you to be my teacher. But I don’t think you want to be my teacher. So I thought I’d give you a job that better aligns with your specific interests.
lines.zh: : 我还是想要你当我老师。可我觉得你不想当我老师。所以我想,不如给你一份更契合你特定兴趣的工作。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Jeeves, I am a rather extraordinary individual. To be frank, I’m very impressive. But the only time you seemed impressed the other day was when I was talking about books.
lines.zh: : Jeeves,我是一个相当非凡的人。坦白讲,我非常令人惊叹。但那天,你唯一显得「被惊叹到」的时刻,是我在聊书的时候。

lines.en: : That’s just...what I’m good at, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 那只是……我擅长的事,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Math and science are important too, yeah. And it does impress me that you’re willing to dive into physics and astronomy at your age, but...those things are different.
lines.zh: : 数学和科学也重要,对。而且,愿意在你这个年纪钻研物理和天文,确实让我印象深刻,但……那些东西不一样。

lines.en: : Anyone can memorize formulas and...star maps or whatever, but not everyone can understand people. And doing that is the key to getting what you want out of life.
lines.zh: : 任何人都能背下公式、或者……星图什么的;但不是所有人都能理解「人」。而理解人,才是从人生中得到你想要的东西的关键。

lines.en: : Maybe. Probably. But also, you probably shouldn’t take my word for that as I still have no idea what I want out of life and I am much older than you.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。多半是。但你也多半不该信我这套——因为我到现在都不知道自己想要什么,而我比你老得多。

lines.en: : What direct correlation does literature have to people, though? I was under the impression that books were just tools used to get certain themes or ideas across.
lines.zh: : 但文学和「人」有什么直接关联?我的印象是,书只是用来传递某些主题或观念的工具。

lines.en: : And to an extent, they are. But they’re also windows into the way an author views the world. Which, in turn, helps us compare and contrast our thoughts and values with theirs. Do you get it?
lines.zh: : 某种程度上,是的。但它们同时也是「作者如何看待世界」的窗口。而这反过来,帮我们把我们的想法和价值观,与他们的进行对比。你懂了吗?

lines.en: : I think so. But isn’t that still just like dissecting an animal at the end of the day? We’re still trying to figure something out by reading, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 我想懂了。可说到底,这不还是解剖动物吗?我们仍然是在通过阅读去搞明白某件事,不是吗?

lines.en: : Look at this way — what’s your favorite book?
lines.zh: : 换个角度想——你最喜欢的书是什么?

lines.en: : The Secret Garden by Frances Hodgson Burnett.
lines.zh: : 弗朗西丝·霍奇森·伯内特的《秘密花园》。

lines.en: : That’s...depressing. And it makes my next question feel kind of loaded, but...how does reading that book make you feel?
lines.zh: : 这……真丧。而且它让我接下来的问题听起来有点别有用心,但是……读那本书,让你有什么感觉?

lines.en: : Free.
lines.zh: : 自由。

lines.en: : Again, dark. But still, you felt something, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 又很丧了。但你还是「感受到」了什么,不是吗?

lines.en: : Oh, so the feeling you get is the important part! Not the underlying message!
lines.zh: : 哦,所以「感受到的东西」才是重要的部分!不是书底层的讯息!

lines.en: : They’re both important, but that’s what sets literature apart from science. There’s an element of humanity to it that other subjects lack.
lines.zh: : 两者都重要,但这正是文学区别于科学的地方。它有一种人性元素,是其他学科缺少的。

lines.en: : And I don’t know how possible it is to ever be happy if you can’t first grasp just how important one’s humanity is.
lines.zh: : 而如果一个人连「人性有多重要」都无法首先把握,我不知道他还有没有可能幸福。

lines.en: : There are a million complex equations out there, and it takes amazing people to solve the vast majority of them. But we are perhaps the most complex equation of all. And many just...lose sight of that.
lines.zh: : 世上有上百万个复杂的方程,解开其中绝大多数需要了不起的人。但我们自己,或许是最复杂的那个方程。而很多人……偏偏看不见这一点。

lines.en: : The only reason I even started tutoring was because I wanted to...test that, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我当初开始做家教,唯一的原因,其实就是想……验证这一点。

lines.en: : Because learning the way other people see things makes more sense to me than learning why Sirius is so bright. Or why water somehow keeps sandcastles standing.
lines.zh: : 因为「学习别人如何看待世界」,比「学习天狼星为什么那么亮」更说得通。或者「为什么水居然能让沙堡立住」。

lines.en: : So you became a tutor because you wanted to understand people better?
lines.zh: : 所以你当家教,是因为你想更好地理解人?

lines.en: : I...think so?
lines.zh: : 我……这么觉得?

lines.en: : I just...kind of said that without thinking much.
lines.zh: : 我只是……随口说的,没怎么过脑。

lines.en: : That’s very interesting, Jeeves. I’ve never approached literature with that perspective before, but I’ll be sure to think more about my feelings moving forward.
lines.zh: : 这非常有趣,Jeeves。我以前从未用这个视角接触过文学,但今后我一定会多思考我自己的感受。

lines.en: : Do whatever you want. I’m just one person with one outlook when things come down to it. And the idea that anyone would be willing to listen to that at all still shocks me sometimes.
lines.zh: : 随你喜欢。归根结底,我只是一个人、只有一种视角。而居然有人愿意听这些,有时候我依然觉得震惊。

lines.en: : I’m the same way, though.
lines.zh: : 我也一样。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思?

lines.en: : I mean I’m confused about why you’re even spending time with me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我是说,我不明白你为什么花时间陪我。

lines.en: : Nobody’s ever given me this much attention before, and I’m not even asking you to. You’re just doing it on your own.
lines.zh: : 从来没有人给过我这么多关注,而我甚至没有要求。你完全是自发的。

lines.en: : Well, either that or Mother put you up to it. But you’re the one who’s been calling me. Even if I previously commanded you to take the lead in terms of my education.
lines.zh: : 嗯,要么是妈妈安排的。但打电话来的人一直是你。哪怕是我之前命令过你、让你主导我的教育。

lines.en: : And while it’s nice...and fun...to be spending time with you...
lines.zh: : 虽然和你相处……很有趣……很开心……

lines.en: : It just makes me feel like you want something.
lines.zh: : 但它只是让我觉得,你有所图。

lines.en: : I hope it’s just a different perspective. And if that’s the case, I’ll know why you chose me.
lines.zh: : 我希望,你要的只是另一个视角。如果是那样,我就知道你为什么选我了。

lines.en: : But, based on personal experience, a person’s wants are never that simple. And, like you said the other day, leveraging a person’s weaknesses allows you to take advantage of them.
lines.zh: : 可是,凭个人经验,一个人的「所欲」从来不会那么简单。而且,就像你前几天说的,利用一个人的弱点,就能占他的便宜。

lines.en: : I’ve got a lot of weaknesses when I really think about it, Jeeves.
lines.zh: : 认真想一想,我的弱点多得是,Jeeves。

lines.en: : You could use me for anything you want and nobody would even care.
lines.zh: : 你想用我做什么都可以,而且根本不会有任何人在乎。

lines.en: : Please don’t say things like that...
lines.zh: : 请别说那种话……

lines.en: : But it’s the truth.
lines.zh: : 可这是事实。

lines.en: : I’m just a failsafe, remember? Disposable.
lines.zh: : 我只是一个「备用保险」,记得吗?一次性的。

lines.en: : You could lock me in a cage and none of my family would even know about it for months.
lines.zh: : 你可以把我锁进笼子,我的家人几个月都不会知道。

lines.en: : In fact, it feels like that’s what they want sometimes. All I do is annoy them. And it’s probably the same for you.
lines.zh: : 事实上,有时候,我感觉那正是他们想要的。我所做的只是烦他们。对你大概也一样。

lines.en: : So if you want something, just say it. You’ve been nice enough to me lately that I wouldn’t mind giving it to you so long as it’s in my power to do so.
lines.zh: : 所以,你想要什么就直说。你最近对我够好了,只要在我能力范围内,我不介意给你。

lines.en: : You’ve more than earned it, Jeeves. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 你已经挣得绰绰有余了,Jeeves。我是认真的。

lines.en: : Even if it’s something irrational.
lines.zh: : 哪怕那是不理性的东西。

lines.en: : Even if it’s something evil.
lines.zh: : 哪怕那是邪恶的东西。

lines.en: : Even if it’s something the world would scorn you for that you’ve wanted to take ever since you first laid eyes on it.
lines.zh: : 哪怕那是全世界都会唾弃你、而你在第一眼看到它时就想要夺走的东西。

lines.en: : No one cares about me.
lines.zh: : 没有人在乎我。

lines.en: : We can do it right here.
lines.zh: : 我们可以就在这里做。

lines.en: : You can lock me in a cage.
lines.zh: : 你可以把我锁进笼子。

lines.en: : Jeeves?...
lines.zh: : Jeeves?……

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I want to know if this is real or not.
lines.zh: : 我想知道,这是不是真的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for asking this so bluntly, but...
lines.zh: : 这样直白地问,很抱歉,但是……

lines.en: : Do you...like me?
lines.zh: : 你……喜欢我吗?

lines.en: Pull the plug
lines.zh: 拔掉插头

lines.en: : Let’s end here for today.
lines.zh: : 我们今天到这里。

lines.en: Tsukasa’s affection has increased to [tsukasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsukasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsukasa_love]!

lines.en: Take it
lines.zh: 拿走它

lines.en: : I’m doing this because I want to.
lines.zh: : 我做这件事,是因为我想要。

lines.en: : No one else is making me.
lines.zh: : 没有任何人逼我。

lines.en: Tsukasa’s affection has increased to [tsukasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsukasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsukasa_love]!
